claims.assertion: Mari says astral projection is a conscious out-of-body experience, occurring naturally, through practice, or by artificial induction; she distinguishes it from lucid dreaming.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: These descriptions are framed as beliefs.

claims.assertion: Mari alleges militaries induce astral projection using drugs, deprivation, and sensory-isolation capsules, then use astral units for remote viewing or facility defense.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari says astral realms reflect inhabitants’ perceptions and can affect the material world, which she describes as generated from them.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
